ours.notes: static binary, no runtime to install (Linux: no libc dependency)

tumf.runtime_kind: Python interpreter uvx resolved for the venv
tumf.notes: venv is the per-package environment uvx materializes under its cache (hardlinked wheel content); uv cache is host-wide and shared between packages, so it is reported for reference only and never summed into the env figure; the interpreter is uv-managed CPython when no system one matches

g0t4.runtime_kind: Node.js (system package: node binary + the npm/corepack the Node.js package ships; global npm installs on this host excluded)
g0t4.notes: package env is the npx cache dir for this package; runtime is the system Node.js install (node binary plus the modules the nodejs package ships); node_modules_dir_total records the whole directory for disclosure
